title: [15/6/2023] Sports Participation
prompt: The graph shows the number of people taking part in 4 kinds of sports in a particular region between 1985 and 2005. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The line graph illustrates how many people participated in four different sports in a particular area from 1985 to 2005.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: In general, while tennis experienced an increase in popularity, rugby saw a decline in participation over the period, with basketball and badminton showing relatively stable numbers. The most significant change in popularity was observed in rugby.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Rugby was the most popular sport at the beginning of the period in 1985, with 240 people participating, considerably higher than tennis which had 150 participants. Subsequently, the number of rugby players decreased to 200 in 1995, before falling dramatically to a 20-year low of 50 players in 2005. This contrasted sharply with tennis's rising popularity, which showed a steady increase in participants to approximately 220 by 2005, making it the most widely played sport by the end of the period.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the other sports, basketball started with 80 players in 1985, about 25 more than badminton. Over the next ten years, basketball participation increased slightly to around 90, while badminton numbers dropped to 45 in 1995. For the remainder of the period, both sports maintained steady participation levels, with their numbers remaining relatively constant until 2005.
